arcs: Argument-scroll (Terminal, winner-verified): hero statement over cinematic still -> logo strip (proof) -> recoloring stat odometer -> the ONE mechanism reveal 'That's the Yard Operating System. Gallery-stack (Gabriel, Stefan — winner-verified): a gallery/type-forward homepage where the WORK is the argument — a scramble-decode type intro assembles on load (after a numeric 1->100 preloader) into a main gallery of figures, each opening on a scroll-position masked inverse-scale reveal; home->project-detail is a page-transition SPA (Gabriel: Astro + Taxi loop; Stefan: Motion AnimatePresence crossfade), the route transition carrying momentum across views. story.thread: Winners pick exactly ONE positional continuation channel and live it hero-to-footer: Terminal runs a scroll-scrubbed per-char recolor the FULL page height so the text substrate itself is the carry; Gabriel rides every figure open on a scroll-position clip-path masked inverse-scale reveal (a clip-path inset synced to a scroll Track that also scales the inner image, Codrops-verified); Stefan repeats the characters-to-word motif across sections over a persistent WebGL grid on a shared virtual-scroll engine. The constant across all element geometries is held to three things: one accent, one easing family (content reveals easeOutExpo (.19,1,.22,1) at .7-1s; color/opacity easeInSine at .2-.3s), one origin logic (everything resolves toward the accent, drawing/wiping/growing from a fixed edge). The channel is POSITIONAL (scroll-position-driven, re-firing every pass) — never a bank of IntersectionObserver fire-once reveals that read inert on the second pass. On MULTI-VIEW portfolios a second momentum carrier is the CSS-native route transition across navigations (View Transitions — Cyd Stumpel; Motion AnimatePresence — Stefan; Taxi loop — Gabriel).
story.copy: First-plural visionary OR a bare name/role/number type block in the hero; second-person imperative at the CTA. Fragments — the line break is the punctuation; the period carries weight; TM sits on the product noun. Proof is named in the reader's own world ('Powering the yards behind the brands you know') or asserted as a dated credential ('Awwwards Jury member since 2020.'), never as adjective stacks or self-narration. Restraint in copy mirrors restraint in chrome: the words state, they do not perform. (Exclamation is not banned corpus-wide — Treize ships 'Activez votre marque !'.)

spectacle_model.recommended_law: Minimalist Phase-4 law: the hero is a committed spectacle scene (curtain + recoloring counter + per-char cascade over the cinematic still, OR a scramble-decoding type intro over the main gallery) — never a quiet opener. Cap LOUD peaks at ONE mid-page climax (the mechanism reveal / the first full-bleed figure / the recoloring odometer band), plus an OPTIONAL second QUIET peak where the deferred <h1> lands in the footer; a portrait-procession may run two loud peaks but no more. CROSS-CUTTING MANDATE: commit exactly one POSITIONAL continuation channel — scroll-scrubbed per-char recolor, masked inverse-scale figure reveals, or a persistent WebGL grid — and live it hero-to-footer so the page NEVER falls silent after the hero; on multi-view portfolios add a CSS-native route transition (View Transitions / AnimatePresence / Taxi) as the cross-navigation carrier. 'Peaks are capped' must not be read as 'quiet after the hero': restraint means the continuation vocabulary is QUIET (one scrubbed/masked/grid channel) rather than a second loud spectacle. The failure mode is a bank of IntersectionObserver fire-once reveals that read inert on the second scroll pass; the winning move is a scroll-position-driven channel that re-fires the whole scroll.

algorithm.decide: Story spine (macrostructure) from brief-declared content type
algorithm.rule: Route on the brief's declared inputs, not on a taste read: a product/SaaS brief with ONE held claim -> argument-scroll, defer the <h1> to the footer. A brief that supplies a body of visual work to show (portfolio/gallery) -> gallery-stack, gallery/type-forward homepage + route-transition SPA. A brief whose primary deliverable is reading/prose AND that explicitly forbids spectacle -> standfirst-stack, even intensity, voice-in-the-chrome. These three are decidable from stated brief facts (one-claim product vs. body-of-work vs. reading-first-no-spectacle); the gallery-vs-standfirst split keys on the explicit no-spectacle constraint, not on a subjective 'which is more editorial' judgment. Never blend two spines.

Press-class elements answer the tap with a 90-160ms flash floor (:active). Image sets swap the desktop pinned/hold-drag strip for swipe-snap-gallery (native scroll-snap riding OS momentum, tap-to-enlarge). Depth on touch comes from scroll, not pointer-parallax.

cta.hover: directional token-wipe inversion — a :before in the dark token sits translate3d(0,100%,0) inside an overflow:hidden pill; hover wipes it up and INVERTS the token pair (accent bg/dark ink -> dark bg/accent ink), transform .7s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), ink recolors over .3s with a .2s delay. Full-strength color the whole way. (Airy-Swiss alt: full-token bg shift to a real darker/lighter step, no motion — never a transparency wash.)

mobile_answer: The archetype's touch strategy is CARRY-BY-SCROLL: the entire signature thread is scroll-position-driven (scrubbed per-char recolor, masked inverse-scale figure reveals, recoloring odometer, WebGL grid), so it survives touch UNCHANGED — the momentum the user worries about disappearing on mobile is exactly the channel that persists, because none of it depends on the pointer. On multi-view portfolios the route/view transition (View Transitions / AnimatePresence / Taxi) is input-agnostic and fires on tap-navigation exactly as on click, so the cross-view momentum beat also survives. Pointer-only states (underline draw, strike-through, nav accent dot, index-row spotlight, custom cursor/mouse-trail) go dormant and are @media(any-hover:hover)-gated so no content is trapped behind a hover. Press-class elements (CTA, tappable rows) answer the tap with a 90-160ms :active flash. Image sets swap the desktop pinned/hold-drag filmstrip for swipe-snap-gallery (native scroll-snap on OS momentum, next-cell peek, tap-to-enlarge — the scored Mobile Excellence line). Depth is scroll-derived, never pointer-parallax (dormant on touch).

gaps.mechanic: A scroll-POSITION-driven masked figure reveal that re-fires every pass: a clip-path inset opens from inset(100% 0 0 0) toward inset(0) WHILE the image scales inversely to scroll progress. Codrops verifies the MECHANIC verbatim — 'clip-path inset combined with a Track to sync it with the scroll that also controls the scaling of the inner image'; the exact amplitude (previously stated as scale(1.2 + track*-0.2)) is NOT in the source and is unverified — treat the numbers as illustrative. Distinct from the manifest's clip-reveal (fire-once, IntersectionObserver) and dolly-zoom (pinned scale toward a focal point) — this is the CONTINUATION carry for the gallery-stack, positional so it never reads inert on the second pass. The single most load-bearing missing mechanic for the momentum law.

A cross-navigation momentum carrier for multi-view portfolios: the home->project-detail transition is crossfaded/morphed instead of a hard reload. Three verified expressions: (a) native View Transitions API + Scroll-Driven Animations (Cyd Stumpel, SOTD 2025-03-09, CSS-native, JS-light); (b) Motion AnimatePresence in a shared Layout, opacity crossfade .5s easeQuadInOut (Stefan, Codrops-verified); (c) a Taxi single-page-app loop with GSAP tweens carrying the dark-home->bright-detail color shift (Gabriel, Codrops-verified). The manifest's spectacle/momentum model was single-scroll hero-to-footer and had NO slot for the inter-view transition, despite the gallery-stack portfolios being multi-view SPAs where that transition is a signature beat. Input-agnostic, so it also carries on touch.

The verified loader/intro for the gallery-stack: a numeric 1->100 preloader (Gabriel 2.8s, values [1..100], 'more stylistic than functional', fade-out slow.in ~.8s) hands off to a scramble-decode type assembly (charset noise -> true string, Gabriel ScrambleText durations [1.2,1.5,0.4,0.2,1,0.6,0.6], expo.out) over the MAIN GALLERY. recipes.json still marks a 'name-card' form MISSING for the gallery-stack macrostructure — but the imageless 'text-only name card that withholds the image' framing was REFUTED (Codrops describes a main image gallery on the homepage). Build the verified pieces (numeric preloader + scramble-decode type intro over a figure gallery), NOT an imageless withholding hero.

A restraint-compatible custom-cursor slot the pointer layer currently lacks: a small monochrome dot that scales/animates over interactive targets, or a lightweight trailing lens/mouse-trail. Verified on Pacome Pertant (Awwwards 'Mouse trail' feature tag). Pointer-only, fully dormant on touch, must never gate content or a11y. Keep it quiet (no color spectacle) to stay inside the archetype. The manifest's element_states enumerate cta/link/figure/index_row/heading/nav and had no cursor slot.

A per-CHAR recolor scrubbed across the FULL page height as a sustained substrate carry — not per-block. text-emphasis-fill's scrub mode brightens WORDS as each block traverses the viewport; Terminal instead runs a per-char recolor tied to global scroll progress so the reading text itself is the continuous thread hero-to-footer. Needs a global-scroll (page-progress) driver and per-char granularity as a variant/mode beyond the current per-block scrub, so the continuation channel can be the text substrate rather than a bank of section reveals. (Terminal's per-char recolor mechanic is CSS-verified across prior rounds and corroborated by the 8.80 Animations sub-score; the full-page-scrub global-driver specifics are partly single-source.)

variation: This section_playbook is one legal costume of the archetype, never THE skeleton. Structure is story-native (SKILL.md Phase 1): the body's sections derive from the universe's spine, then check against these roles for coverage — never the reverse. The axes serial winners measurably rotate between builds (21-artifact corpus, 5 studios): body content archetype + item counts, the ONE signature device (never reused across builds), the close mechanism, the hero medium, the index/HUD costume. What persists as DNA: type grammar, the motion register (the register itself, never the named reading/interaction kit — that kit is a device, rotated per build like the signature), annotation grammar as a form, engineering architecture. The same content archetype + item count + close mechanism recurring across two different-brand builds has zero winner precedent.
gaps_note: All orders closed July 2026 (completeness program) — entries kept as the winner-cited mechanic-spec grammar; per-entry status carries the resolution. For a builder each entry cuts two ways: the library form it merged into is the first reach, and the mechanic spec is a build recipe you may author directly at library quality when the winner's original shape fits the world better.
